question: Active HRSA Section 330 grant (H80 award)
help_text: Without active 330 grant, FQHC designation is lost; no access to FQHC capital programs.

question: HRSA scope of project (approved service sites & services)
help_text: Capital project must be within approved scope.

question: BPHC Operational Site Visit (OSV) results — most recent
help_text: Outstanding conditions flag management risk for CDFI lenders.

question: UDS reports — 3 most recent years
help_text: Core data for CDFI/NMTC applications. Patient demographics, quality measures, financial data.

question: Section 330 compliance checklist — 19 program requirements
help_text: CDFI lenders verify compliance as underwriting criterion.

question: FTCA deeming letter — current
help_text: Loss of deeming = insurance cost increase = affects debt service capacity.

question: 340B Drug Pricing Program enrollment and compliance
help_text: 340B revenue material for CDFI loan underwriting.

question: Health Center Program Compliance Manual attestation
help_text: Annual attestation required by HRSA.

question: IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter
help_text: Required for all FQHC financing channels.

question: Board composition documentation — 51%+ patient majority
help_text: Section 330 requirement; verified by CDFI lenders.

question: Articles of Incorporation & Bylaws
help_text: Must reflect FQHC governance requirements.

question: Board authorization resolution for financing
help_text: Specific to the financing transaction.

question: Existing debt schedule & loan documents
help_text: Prior HRSA facility grants may have reverter clauses.

question: HRSA property records & federal interest inventory
help_text: Federal interest affects collateral pledging even for CDFI loans.

question: List of pending litigation
help_text: Non-FTCA claims must be disclosed to CDFI lenders.

question: Insurance certificates
help_text: Property, D&O, general liability required by CDFI lenders.

question: State FQHC/clinic license
help_text: Verify state-specific requirements.

question: Medicare enrollment (CMS-855A/B)
help_text: PPS rate revenue is key to debt service capacity.

question: Medicaid enrollment & managed care contracts
help_text: ~45% of revenue; CDFI underwriters assess Medicaid concentration risk.

question: CLIA certificate(s) for all lab sites
help_text: Standard compliance verification.

question: State pharmacy license (if on-site pharmacy/340B)
help_text: Required for 340B revenue stream.

question: Audited financial statements (3 most recent FYs) with Single Audit
help_text: Single Audit findings on HRSA grants are heavily weighted by CDFI lenders.

question: Interim financial statements (YTD)
help_text: Within 60-90 days of application.

question: 5-year financial projections
help_text: Must account for grant volatility and Medicaid policy risk. Below-market CDFI rates improve projections.

question: Payor mix with FQHC-specific detail
help_text: Granular breakdown required for CDFI underwriting.

question: Days cash on hand (DCOH)
help_text: CDFI lenders may accept lower DCOH than bond market (45-60 days).

question: Operating margin (with and without grant revenue)
help_text: Grant-dependent operations are a material risk factor.

question: Debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) — historical
help_text: CDFI lenders may accept 1.10-1.20x DSCR (lower than bond market).

question: HRSA Change in Scope (CIS) approval — if adding new site
help_text: Hard gate for new site projects.

question: Community needs assessment (CNA) — current
help_text: Core to CDFI/NMTC applications; demonstrates need for expanded capacity.

question: Construction budget and timeline
help_text: Must align with HRSA budget if any grant-funded component.

question: CDFI application narrative (organizational capacity, project impact)
help_text: CHC Capital Fund, IFF, LISC, Capital Link have specific formats. Application quality directly affects approval.

question: Community impact documentation
help_text: Census data, health disparities, access metrics. UDS data, HRSA data warehouse, census tract analysis for low-income qualification.

question: Project pro forma with CDFI/NMTC terms
help_text: Below-market rates, NMTC 7-year compliance period, leverage structure.

question: Low-income census tract qualification documentation (NMTC)
help_text: FQHC project site must be in or serve qualifying census tracts. CDFI Fund mapping tool.

question: NMTC CDE application (if seeking new allocation)
help_text: Highly competitive (25% approval rate). Only if CDE doesn't already have allocation.

question: HRSA grant application for supplemental capital funds
help_text: Capital Improvement Program (CIP), ARPA-H, other periodic competitions.

question: State FQHC capital grant application (if available)
help_text: Some states (CA, NJ, MA) have specific FQHC capital programs.
